note: Light presets (docs/light/PLAN.md). Directions are given in image terms for the front camera; the subject never changes, so the light is the only variable.

pattern.ja: 組み合わせライティング

forms.setting: standing on a seamless mid-grey studio backdrop and floor
forms.desc: one large soft light directly behind the camera at lens height, even shadowless light on the whole front, the sphere lit almost evenly with the highlight at its centre, minimal shadow
forms.keep: large soft light at the camera axis, shadowless front, centred sphere highlight
checks: 正面均匀、几乎没有阴影

forms.setting: standing on a seamless mid-grey studio backdrop and floor
forms.desc: one hard light directly in front of the mannequin and 45 degrees above it, a small symmetrical shadow under the nose ridge and chin, cheekbone planes lit evenly on both sides, sphere highlight top-centre, short shadow straight down behind
forms.keep: hard light front and 45 degrees above, symmetrical shadow under the head, sphere highlight top-centre
checks: 阴影左右对称、在下颌下

forms.setting: standing on a seamless mid-grey studio backdrop and floor
forms.desc: one soft key light 30 degrees to image-left and 30 degrees above, the shadow of the head's nose ridge forming a small loop down toward image-right, the right side of the figure in gentle shadow, sphere highlight upper-left
forms.keep: soft key 30 degrees image-left and 30 degrees up, small loop shadow to image-right, sphere highlight upper-left

forms.setting: standing on a seamless mid-grey studio backdrop and floor
forms.desc: one key light 45 degrees to image-left and 45 degrees above, no fill, the image-right side of the head in shadow except a small lit triangle on the cheek plane under the eye socket, deep shadows on the right half of the torso, sphere half-lit with the terminator crossing diagonally
forms.keep: key 45 degrees image-left and 45 up, no fill, lit triangle on the shadow-side cheek, diagonal terminator on the sphere
checks: 暗侧脸颊上一个小三角亮区

forms.setting: standing on a seamless mid-grey studio backdrop and floor
forms.desc: one hard light exactly 90 degrees to image-left at head height, the figure split vertically down its centre line: image-left half lit, image-right half in deep shadow, the sphere exactly half lit
forms.keep: hard light 90 degrees image-left, figure split down the centre, sphere exactly half lit
checks: 身体正好一半亮一半暗

forms.setting: standing on a seamless black studio backdrop and floor
forms.desc: two hard lights behind the mannequin, one at image-left rear and one at image-right rear, both 30 degrees above, drawing thin bright edges along both sides of the head, shoulders, arms and legs, the front almost black, the sphere showing two thin crescent edges
forms.keep: two rear lights tracing thin bright edges on both sides, near-black front, black backdrop

forms.setting: standing on a seamless mid-grey studio backdrop and floor
forms.desc: one hard light directly overhead, bright top of the head and shoulders, the face-front and torso falling into shadow below the brow line, short round shadow pooled under the feet, sphere lit only on top
forms.keep: hard light straight overhead, bright tops, dark front below the brow, short pooled shadow

forms.setting: standing on a seamless mid-grey studio backdrop and floor
forms.desc: one light low on the floor in front of the mannequin pointing up, the undersides of the chin, chest and arms lit, upward-cast shadows on the head and the backdrop behind, an unnatural eerie mood, sphere lit from below
forms.keep: floor light in front pointing up, lit undersides, upward shadows on the backdrop

forms.setting: standing on a seamless mid-grey studio backdrop and floor
forms.desc: a large soft light in front and 40 degrees above plus a soft fill below in front at chest height, very even flattering light on the front, faint shadow under the chin, two highlights on the sphere (one top, one bottom)
forms.keep: soft key above front plus soft fill below front, even front, two sphere highlights

forms.setting: standing on a seamless mid-grey studio backdrop and floor
forms.desc: a soft key 45 degrees to image-left and 30 degrees above, a weaker fill from image-right at camera height, and a hair light from behind above lighting the top edge of the head and shoulders, moderate contrast, sphere showing key highlight upper-left and a faint rim on top
forms.keep: soft key 45 degrees image-left, weaker fill image-right, rear hair light on the top edge

forms.setting: standing on a seamless pure white studio backdrop and floor
forms.desc: bright soft light flooding the whole set from the front and both sides, the backdrop pure white, the mannequin light and airy with very faint soft shadows, almost no dark tones
forms.keep: bright soft even light everywhere, pure white backdrop, very faint shadows

forms.setting: standing on a seamless black studio backdrop and floor
forms.desc: one narrow soft light 60 degrees to image-left and above, lighting only the image-left edge planes of the head, shoulder, arm and the sphere, everything else falling into black, the backdrop black
forms.keep: one narrow light from image-left at 60 degrees, only the left planes lit, black everywhere else
checks: 只有左侧几个面被照亮

forms.setting: standing in front of a seamless white backdrop that is lit brightly from behind
forms.desc: the backdrop evenly bright white, no light on the front of the mannequin or the sphere, both reading as clean solid dark silhouettes with crisp outlines
forms.keep: bright white backdrop, no front light, clean dark silhouettes
